```{=html}
<div class="fi-invite">
  <p class="fi-invite-lead">FRESH helps you understand nutrition and eat a little healthier with less effort.</p>
  <ul class="fi-invite-list">
    <li>Look up or scan any food to see how five expert rating systems score it.</li>
    <li>Import a recipe from TikTok, a website or a photo, and make it healthier one change at a time.</li>
    <li>Plan your week's dinners and get a grocery list.</li>
    <li>Build your diet signature and watch it grow as you make healthier choices.</li>
  </ul>

  <div class="fi-invite-actions">
    <a id="fi-invite-get" class="fi-invite-btn" href="#" hidden>Get FRESH</a>
    <a id="fi-invite-open" class="fi-invite-btn fi-invite-btn-quiet" href="fresh://invite">I have FRESH: open my invite</a>
  </div>
  <p id="fi-invite-soon" class="fi-invite-note">FRESH is in a free test release on iPhone. The install link will be on this page soon.</p>

  <p id="fi-invite-code-line" class="fi-invite-note" hidden>Or open FRESH, go to Account, and enter this code: <strong id="fi-invite-code"></strong></p>

  <p class="fi-invite-note">Accepting connects your account to your friend's. Nothing is shared between you yet.</p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // The public TestFlight link, set once Apple approves the external test group; App Store link later.
  var INSTALL_URL = "";
  var raw = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("code") || "";
  var code = raw.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9-]/g, "").slice(0, 32);
  var open = document.getElementById("fi-invite-open");
  if (code) {
    open.href = "fresh://invite?code=" + encodeURIComponent(code);
    document.getElementById("fi-invite-code").textContent = code;
    document.getElementById("fi-invite-code-line").hidden = false;
  }
  if (INSTALL_URL) {
    var get = document.getElementById("fi-invite-get");
    get.href = INSTALL_URL;
    get.hidden = false;
    document.getElementById("fi-invite-soon").hidden = true;
  }
})();
</script>
```
